name: Redstone Torch Random Tick
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: 2No2Name
description: Redstone Torch Random Tick makes burnt out redstone torches be reactived by random ticks, similar to older minecraft versions. This only affects non-scheduled, burnt-out torches, avoiding breaking any redstone contraptions!
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
